## Markdown product briefs · quality-v10
Create and Regenerate develop the original transcript with a proposed behavioral persona, US keyword intent, recent evidence, numeric Markdown callouts and serious blue/red analysis. No new images. Four searches, rolling 24-month search filter, publication-date checks, up to 12 pages + 4 validated redirects. Four model calls maximum. Numeric keyword volumes unavailable until an actual provider is connected; never generated by the model.

Original audio remains in the app; source transcript and reports archived under generation-quality-v10. Existing v9 image retrieval retained for prior reports. Research cache versioned; every generation remains fresh.
